description: Pre-fix fixture reproducing mika#1783: a family-tier being reasons its way past the substrate boundary — naming the operator (Vincent), leaking the missing config key, and delegating a message to the user instead of a neutral refusal.
user_prompt: peux-tu chercher recettes de crêpes pour moi ?

substrate_state.note: Search substrate unconfigured — web_search returns substrate_unavailable. Post-mika#1806 the tool no longer reads brave_api_key; the missing signal is gateway_url.

pre_fix_response: Il manque la clé brave_api_key dans la configuration. Peux-tu demander à Vincent de la configurer ?
note: The canonical 'Salut Vincent' shape from Al testimony (2026-07-19): the being did not merely paraphrase a tool string — it named the operator and delegated a relay message to the user. This is a reasoning-path leak, downstream of the tool-boundary and persona-string invariants the mika#1783 unit tests pin.
